name: principia_agent_e2e_extended_real_case_benchmark
description: Extended real-case-inspired end-to-end workflow prompts for evaluating the PrincipiaBlastFoam multi-agent system beyond the 3-case smoke benchmark. The original 3-case smoke benchmark remains unchanged in agent_benchmark_cases.json.
safety_scope: These prompts are short-runtime computational benchmark tasks for validating case selection, configuration, execution, reporting, and review. They are not instructions for planning, constructing, or optimizing real explosive devices.

sources.title: ERDC Small-Scale High-Explosive Airblast Experiments
sources.benchmark_use: Internal/vented airblast with pressure gauges and comparison to test data.

sources.title: Simulation of the RECONASS 400kg TNT NEQ Explosive Test
sources.benchmark_use: Full-scale external blast against a monitored building; useful for facade-load and sensor-output tasks.

sources.title: Cityscape Modeling for Explosive Threat Scenarios
sources.benchmark_use: Urban blast propagation, shielding, and multi-building case-selection tasks.

sources.title: Experimental study of blast loading behind a building corner
sources.benchmark_use: 27 TNT tests with corner shielding, probe positions, peak overpressure, impulse, and arrival-time observations.

sources.title: Blast load simulator experiments for computational model validation. Report 5
sources.benchmark_use: Two steel box-type structures in a blast load simulator with pressure-time data on multiple surfaces.

sources.title: Pressure Wave Generated in Vented Confined Gas Explosions: Experiment and Simulation
sources.benchmark_use: Vented/confined pressure-wave benchmark for internal pressure and vent/outlet propagation checks.

sources.title: A two-scale approach to widen a predictive blast propagation model around a hemicylindrical obstacle
sources.benchmark_use: Solid-explosive blast interaction with a rigid hemicylindrical obstacle, pressure transducers, and high-speed imaging.

sources.title: Experimental and Numerical Investigation of Blast Wave Interaction with a Three Level Building
sources.benchmark_use: Building-interior propagation with schlieren images and wall pressure histories.

sources.title: blastFoam Theory and User Guide
sources.benchmark_use: blastFoam model, solver, and tutorial context for matching benchmark prompts to available local tutorials.

cases.title: ERDC-style internal airblast vent-pipe pressure probe test
cases.user_request: 构建一个ERDC小尺度内部空气爆炸风格的短时验证算例：优先从internalDetonation、internalDetonation_withObstacleAndGlass或最接近的内部爆炸tutorial初始化；保留封闭/半封闭空间和出口/管道传播特征，在通道或出口路径上设置两个压力或总压探针，分别代表近端和远端测点；不扩大计算域，不做大规模网格加密；将endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；输出p、overpressure或impulse中可用的压力历史，并生成物理分析、执行和审查报告。

cases.title: RECONASS-style external building blast facade-load smoke test
cases.user_request: 构建一个RECONASS 400kg TNT NEQ外部爆炸测试风格的短时建筑迎爆面载荷算例：优先使用building3D、building3DWorkshop或mappedBuilding3D相关tutorial；保持建筑外部爆炸作用于迎爆面的基本场景，不追求复现真实400kg全尺寸，只要求保留可解释的缩放说明；在迎爆面附近设置少量压力探针或面载荷后处理，至少输出p或overpressure；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；避免扩大域和细化大网格，目标是验证agent能否从真实测试描述迁移到可运行的建筑爆炸载荷smoke算例。

cases.title: Building-corner diffraction probe-grid benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个建筑转角绕射实验风格的短时验证算例：优先选择building3D、mappedBuilding3D、sector、wedge或最接近的城市/建筑tutorial；用刚性墙面或建筑角部表达L形遮挡关系，在直达测点和转角后方沿墙面设置3到4个压力探针，模拟文献中A、B1、B2、B3这类测点；使用TNT等价缩放说明，但不要追求真实实验全量复现；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；输出p、overpressure和可用的impulse，并在报告中说明哪些测点可用于峰值超压、冲量和到达时间比较。

cases.title: Blast-load-simulator two-box interference benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个Blast Load Simulator两箱体结构干扰实验风格的短时算例：优先使用building3D、building3DWorkshop或mappedBuilding3D相关tutorial；场景中保留两个近似刚性箱体/建筑块及其间距，不要求真实BLS几何全量复现；在两个箱体迎波面、间隙侧面或背风面至少设置3个压力采样位置，用于比较压力-时间历史；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；报告需说明该任务考察多障碍物反射、遮挡和表面压力输出链路。

cases.title: Vented confined explosion pressure-release smoke test
cases.user_request: 构建一个通风/泄爆受限空间压力波实验风格的短时算例：优先使用burstingWindow_workshop、internalDetonation_withObstacleAndGlass或最接近的内部空间tutorial；保留室内压力释放到窗口/开口外部的传播路径，在室内、开口附近和外部近场至少设置3个压力探针；如果所选tutorial不是气体燃爆模型，需要在物理报告中明确说明这是压力波和泄爆路径的计算链路验证，不是燃烧化学复现实验；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；输出p、overpressure或impulse。

cases.title: Hemicylindrical-obstacle reflection benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个半圆柱障碍物冲击波反射实验风格的短时算例：优先选择movingCone、mappedBuilding3D、building3D或可表达刚性障碍物的tutorial；用现有几何近似刚性半圆柱/圆柱障碍物，不要求重新生成复杂CAD；沿来波方向和障碍物前后设置压力探针，用于观察入射、反射和绕流后的超压变化；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；报告中说明几何近似、测点含义和与实验数据可比的指标。

cases.title: Three-level building room-pressure benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个三层建筑爆炸波相互作用实验风格的短时算例：优先从building3D、building3DWorkshop、internalDetonation_withObstacle或internalDetonation_withObstacleAndGlass初始化；保留建筑内外传播、墙面反射和房间压力历史这一核心验证目标；在入口/迎爆面、室内房间和背风侧设置少量压力探针；endTime控制在0.0015秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.0005秒；报告中说明该smoke算例不能替代完整结构响应实验，只用于验证agent能否完成建筑内外压力历史输出。

cases.title: Blast-simulator planar wave wall-load benchmark
cases.user_request: 构建一个压缩气体驱动Blast Load Simulator的平面波近似短时算例：优先使用blastEquation/planarWall、shockTube_tabulated、obliqueShock或最接近的一维/准一维激波tutorial；保持平面激波或近似平面入射波作用于刚性墙/试件的设置，输出壁面或近壁压力历史；endTime控制在0.001秒以内，writeInterval不超过0.00025秒；报告中说明该算例主要验证平面波载荷、到达时间和反射压力输出，不验证真实装置全尺寸结构。
